title: campanula mollis f. longicornis
intro: Campanula mollis f. longicornis, commonly known as the long-haired bellflower, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in soothing digestive issues and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Campanula mollis f. longicornis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, contributing to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
